title: Gulbarga Fort

buildingCutout.basis: The individually mapped Bala Qila occupies this footprint. The occupied fort precinct remains an open site around it.

terrainReference.basis: Unchanged Copernicus GLO-30 at the mapped east gate. Local wall foundation elevations follow the original ground grid.

mapIdentity.scope: Named OSM relation 9149272 fixes the site limits. The paired mapped sets of wall lines preserve the visible rampart pattern. Individual OSM ways separately locate the east portal, central Bala Qila, and the mosque.

note: The nineteenth-century Deen Dayal photographs and the Survey of India plate constrain the masonry batter, cylindrical bastions, stepped fort profile, roof domes and mosque arcades.
